Discovery of the electron and proton: Thomson found the electron, Goldstein the proton rays and Chadwick the neutron.
Rutherford's alpha scattering and nuclea: Alpha scattering showed a small dense positive nucleus and mostly empty space.
Bohr's model and electron shells: Shells K, L, M hold 2, 8, 18 electrons; valency depends on outer electrons.
Atomic number, mass number, isotopes and: Isotopes: same Z, different A. Isobars: same A, different Z.
